subject: Added support for cluster with replicas (#313)
reason: The change modifies only the project's CI script (build.sh) and its Python integration-test framework (integration/valkey_search_test_case.py and test files): it adds replica support to the test harness itself — new Node/ReplicationGroup helpers, parametrized fixtures, a renamed temp directory. No module source (src/) or runtime behavior of valkey-search changes, so the module binaries at the change and at its parent behave identically and no fuzzer scenario can reach anything the change altered.
